Pakistan to host Makkah Defence Alliance meeting! 🤝
According to Dawn, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar said on Monday that Pakistan will host the next meeting of the Makkah Defence Alliance's apex committee, the Strategic Political and Defence Committee, hopefully at the end of this month in Islamabad. The Makkah Joint Defence Agreement was signed on Aug 7 by Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye; under it, an attack on any one of them counts as an attack on all. Dar said new members may be admitted about one year after the alliance is established.
What does this alliance mean for Pakistan? Tell us in the comments 👇
